reviews.text: Eleanor had a great experience during her training time and we loved the updates and tips on how we can give her the queues she needs to be a happier puppy. :-).  the recap was excellent. Thank you Mica!! and the entire Ranch staff!!!

I found The Ranch Dog Training a few years ago and went to them for help with my reactive dog. We were the fourth family that he had gone to and as such we didn’t know much about his history. It was clear he needed some guidance and The Ranch was the perfect fit. Our first visit was a three week board and train session in which we got daily updates and videos of his progress. We also went to them for help with guided training sessions and will again go to them for a week of boarding. Highly recommend them for anyone needing help with a pup that needs a little bit more attention than regular.
Oakley, my German Shepherd, jumps on the front door when we arrive. She’s that eager to get in and see her friends.

The Ranch is amazing. I don’t know where my dog and I would be without Lia. Rhee did the 2-week board and train and came back a different dog. The whole time he was there, I got reports, pictures, videos and got to talk to the trainers every day, which really helped. I saw what they did with him and when I picked him up, they taught me too.

We just did a refresher training at home a few months later and will be continuing that every few months, I’m sure. He’ll be going back again for another week in August while I’m out of town because it’s the only place I trust to leave my pup.

100/10 would recommend.

I always feel very good about leaving Ellie here, I know they take good care of her.  What I like best is that they recognize that all dogs have different temperaments and take that into consideration when caring for them.

We’ve been coming here for a few years for daycare, boarding, and training and we love the staff. Our pup can be anxious, but they always know how to get him out of his shell with patience and care. He loves the staff cuddles and we always enjoy the daily report cards and photos.

Best dog trainers ever! Manny has catered every training session to our dog, Toad. They have been very understanding and work with and around out schedule. Couldn’t be happier with our board and train/daycare experience. Attendants know Toad well and he has a great time. Photos from his time in the yard are adorable
LOVE the Ranch. They are always so welcoming and take such great care of Eleanor!!  Great staff, nice facilities. Amazing team!!

We literally tell anyone with a dog in LA that they should bring them to The Ranch. We’ve tried a few places in the area which were fine but our dog would come out looking shell shocked. Not the case with The Ranch! From the detailed daily report cards (shout out to Amara), you can tell everyone there takes great care with the dogs and are attentive to their needs. Miso can’t wait to come see her doggie and human friends at The Ranch.
